Create a refined professional product-design MOODBOARD, landscape 1536 x 1024. ONE coherent art direction only. A tasteful studio presentation with large readable typography, generous spacing, actual visual materials, color swatches, typography specimen, one focused mobile app content sample at natural 390 x 844 proportions (no bezel, status bar or device shadow), and a small AI identity study. Target North American postpartum mothers. Priority order is reliable practical assistance FIRST, respectful emotional support SECOND, clear guidance THIRD. Reduce work; avoid grading mothers. This is concept exploration, not a final screen or fixed information architecture.
Reference image 1 is the existing Chinese prototype ONLY as product context: records / crying support / diaper-image support, not its old doctor mascot or layout. Reference image 2 is current Momcozy public homepage ONLY for family resemblance (deep burgundy, white, mature approachable aesthetic); don't copy its commerce hero, products, medical claims or photography. Brand page machine-extracted colors: #692A3A primary, #1A1A1A text, #FFFFFF background; Montserrat observed, not official brand standard. Any other colors are proposals. Date anchor 2026-10-19; do not need visible dates.
Mobile sample must show the SAME narrow task across this exploration: a manually entered bottle-feed record ready for review, not AI automated logging. Text: 'Momcozy AI', 'Review your entry', 'Bottle feed', '3 fl oz', 'Today, 10:30 AM', 'Not saved yet', primary 'Save entry', secondary 'Edit', quiet support sentence 'You can update this later.' Make only one primary action dominant, text charcoal high contrast, body 16px. No fabricated health score, diagnosis, dashboard KPI, streak or unsolicited new features. Clearly label the app sample 'Concept · sample data'. Show a very small AI identifier near a support line, never a giant character.
Board has English title plus short Chinese subtitle, 3 keywords, 5 labeled swatches with hex, a material/lighting study, typography specimen, mobile sample, and three tiny AI presence states 'Ready / Working / Done' with explicit labels; material textures are inspirational only and do not go behind app text. Footer 'Exploration v0.1 · Proposed palette · Not an official brand guide'. No medical coat, stethoscope, childish cartoon, huge eyes, gendered human avatar, anime, toy mascot, sci-fi hologram, shiny rainbow orb, excessive shadow. Avoid fixed emotional reassurance in routine success; show 'Entry saved' for Done in state strip. Clear readable type, no clipping. The visual should feel useful, grounded, mature and quietly supportive.
Direction name 'Quiet Order' / '温暖有序'. Keywords 'Capable · Clear · Considerate'. Palette: #692A3A Burgundy, #FAF7F2 Ivory, #E9DED4 Oat, #DCE5DE Sage tint, #282725 Ink. A restrained editorial moodboard: asymmetric grid, ample warm ivory negative space, crisp aligned rules. Macro folded cream cotton, matte off-white ceramic shallow dish, soft natural light as beautiful photographic studies. Typography Montserrat headline and plain highly legible sans body. App: structured form with large amount, clearly labeled rows, divider lines, generous 16px corners only where useful; burgundy Save button. AI identity: a small sculptural continuous folded ribbon/loop with a protected central void, matte ivory with discreet burgundy inner fold, grounded and non-anthropomorphic. No face. Form is distinctive at tiny sizes. Ready/Working/Done show subtle orientation or opening changes, accompanied by text. Warmth from material + language; hierarchy remains task first. Make this suitable for a real senior designer's design review.

Direction name 'Soft Presence' / '轻柔陪伴'. Keywords 'Helpful · Warm · Respectful'. Palette: #692A3A Burgundy, #FFF9F4 Warm white, #EBD4CA Clay tint, #E5DFD7 Linen, #302B2A Cocoa ink. Richly art-directed warm editorial board: soft crop photography of folded linen and chalky warm ceramic, gentle afternoon shadow; a few broad rounded visual zones with clean typography and ample breathing room. Typography warm humanist sans for body and Montserrat headings. The focused mobile app content uses a compact supportive conversation context ABOVE a large clearly structured manually entered record review, with information and Save entry dominating. Tiny message 'Your entry is ready to review.' No large chat composer; no repetitive comforting paragraph. It is a task-oriented review in a conversational context. A soft rounded draft surface with dark typography, very light clay background around only a portion of the board; burgundy Save entry. AI identity a mature abstract smooth asymmetrical pebble made of two joined matte ceramic volumes, cream upper and dusty clay underside, no eyes or mouth, no baby-like head/body. Three tiny states gently separate/rejoin the two volumes, readable status labels. Emphasize practical helpfulness rather than dependence or sentimentality. The material study is a visual metaphor, not texture applied to controls.

Direction name 'Clear Rhythm' / '清晰从容'. Keywords 'Organized · Light · Dependable'. Palette: #692A3A Burgundy, #FFFFFF White, #E9EFF2 Mist blue, #526977 Slate, #202A30 Ink. Clean airy editorial board with broad white ground, a few pale blue fields, precise vertical rhythm and confident humanist typography. Material studies: frosted glass edge in soft daylight and a flat folded cotton textile, quiet real-world textures, not a cold laboratory. Montserrat titles, readable plain sans body with tabular numerals. The one mobile sample is the SAME manually entered bottle-feed review task, composed as an elegantly linear time-stamped entry, clear summary hierarchy, labels, Edit, and dominant burgundy Save entry at bottom. 'Not saved yet' highly legible. Do not add a history list or dashboard: keep it a single event review. AI identity: a distinctive small open double-arc form, two softly curved matte bands in slate blue and warm white, visually associated with organizing a space; sculptural but flat enough to become a 24px identity mark. No lens, robot face, or magical orb. Three tiny states change arc spacing; status text conveys actual meaning, never color alone. Include a typography specimen that makes 3 fl oz and 10:30 AM easy to scan. This feels organized without being clinical, elevated without premium-fashion decoration.
